sql: SELECT [sale/return] kind,COUNT(*) n,MIN([qty_sold(kg)]) min_qty,MAX([qty_sold(kg)]) max_qty,MIN([discount(%)]) min_discount,MAX([discount(%)]) max_discount FROM veg_txn_df GROUP BY [sale/return] UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_wholesale_keys',COUNT(*),NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM (SELECT item_code,whsle_date FROM veg_whsle_df GROUP BY item_code,whsle_date HAVING COUNT(*)>1) UNION ALL SELECT 'unmatched_transactions',COUNT(*),NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM veg_txn_df t LEFT JOIN veg_whsle_df w ON t.item_code=w.item_code AND t.txn_date=w.whsle_date WHERE w.item_code IS NULL
